text:
isabel-cho: Hey team, Isabel here  starting CS today. Stuck on a few items: HubSpot contact import fails, Aircall softphone shows incoming but doesn't connect, and I can't find the trial-to-paid playbook. Who should I mention?

frank-ops: welcome @isabel! ping me for HubSpot/Aircall. what's the email you signed up with? also, we store sandbox creds in 1Password under 'cs-sandbox'.

isabel-cho: isabel.cho@redwood.ai. thanks.

ana-cs-mgr: hi Isabel welcome. I'll add you to the CS onboarding card and schedule a 1:1. Playbooks live in Notion > Customer Success > Playbooks. Zoe will drop quick links.

zoe-onboarding: added you to Notion and mirrored the trial->paid PDF into Notion under Quick Start. Also uploaded a short Loom that walks through the qualification rubric.

frank-ops: created ticket ACC-8037 for HubSpot + Aircall. ETA ~2 hours. Access-bot: ACC-8037 created and assigned to frank-ops.

isabel-cho: I can log into HubSpot but imports fail with "CSV schema mismatch".

frank-ops: send the CSV to me or drop in Drive > CS > Imports. common issue is missing "Email" header or extra columns. I'll normalize and import.

zoe-onboarding: FYI the canned replies are in Drive > CS > Templates. I've copied the top 10 into Notion under "Day 0" for quick paste.

isabel-cho: Aircall softphone still shows incoming but call doesn't connect nothing rings.

frank-ops: swapped your number to +1 (415) 555-2099. Give it 5 mins. Also check browser site mic/camera permissions if using web softphone.

isabel-cho: switching number fixed it, thanks. quick question: where do we log a call disposition vs. a HubSpot task?

ana-cs-mgr: dispositions go in the HubSpot "Disposition" property on the activity. If there's an action item for the AE, create a HubSpot task and use the escalation tag.

zoe-onboarding: pro tip: use disposition "escalate-to-sales" and mention the AE handle in the activity comment so SalesOps can auto-pick it up.

gong-bot: Gong invite sent to isabel.cho@redwood.ai. Playlist added: "CS - New Hire Essentials".

isabel-cho: got Gong, but recordings show 0 results for the onboarding tag.

zoe-onboarding: search tag:onboarding_cs or playlist "CS - New Hire Essentials". If you still see nothing, refresh the app or accept the invite link again.

frank-ops: HubSpot import done imported 25 sample contacts. Check HubSpot > Contacts > Lists > "CS Onboard Samples".

isabel-cho: can confirm samples are visible. thanks! Another ask: product one-pagers link in Notion is 404.

zoe-onboarding: fixed Drive perms and re-linked the one-pagers. Drive > Sales & CS > Collateral > One-Pagers. I'll pin the top 5 to Notion Quick Start.

ana-cs-mgr: first-week checklist for Isabel: 1) HubSpot + sample contacts imported, 2) Aircall test call + make one outbound, 3) Watch 6 Gong clips (listen & take notes), 4) Complete "CS fundamentals" LMS module, 5) Shadow 3 live calls. We'll schedule shadows this afternoon.

isabel-cho: perfect. last tiny thing: where do we request longer-term access to onboarding recordings? default retention is fine but I'd like to keep 2-3 clips for my notes.

zoe-onboarding: retention default is 90 days for onboarding clips. For export request, DM me and I'll file a retention export; add reason and clip IDs if you have them.

isabel-cho: awesome, thanks all! I'll follow up here if anything else stalls. :raised_hands:
